title: Read-only Claude children are refused Engram `show` with `observations: true`, a read
outcome: A read-only child can read every window that Engram's `show` offers, while tracker writes stay refused.
acceptance: A read-only Claude delegation's `show` with `observations: true` succeeds, and a test covers each current `show` read mode (notes, gates, note, full, history, evaluations, evaluation, criterion_links, observations, after) against the admission list
Writes and undeclared arguments stay refused, with a test, and the list's coverage is checked against Engram's current schema so a new read mode doesn't silently fail
